Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 39 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Sharda - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms

Scene 1: The fishermen's village - Day

[Ishaan stands in the village. Pallavi, Sanjay and Sharda stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Sanjay, what's the plan today?"

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Ishaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
